Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the inspection checks
I1, which must be performed every five years as indicated by
Y5 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit
 must be issued.
Circuit breaker
 isolation and earthing is required.
Wear your
 safety helmet, etc.
Change
 remote/local control switch to local position.
Tools
and Equipment
Multimeter,
 blower, gas detector, buzzer, screwdriver and set of common keys.
Work to be Carried Out
Check
supply voltage.
Check
number of switching operations.
Check
screw joints of the electrical connections by pulling, retighten if necessary.
Check
pull-relief's at cables.
Check
mechanical connections at drive or auxiliary switch by visual control far
tightness and wear.
Check
mechanical position indicator.
Clean
protective pipe of the position indicator by means of a cleaning a gent
containing soap
Grease
threaded spindle and pain bearing of auxiliary
switch (41)
Grease
right-angle gear (8)
Check
functioning of torque clutch rated value of slip friction torque. max 10 Nm,
min. 7Nm
Check
density of shaft seal in housing cover (9 and 1 or 10) by sniffing.
Check
functioning of auxiliary switch contacts.
Check
functioning of heating resistor.
Check
contact penetration depth rated valve.
 Max. 138 mm/min.126 mm until touching/separation of
contacts stroke of switch rod 177+1-2
mm.
Check
wear of annular contacts and switch rod. 
1), 2)
Check
insulating shaft with threaded spindle (6) and universal joints far damages and
grease if necessary
Grease
bevel gearing (13). 
1), (2
Execute
test switching operations.
Check
electrical position signals (position indicator)
Check
running time of drive.
Compare
with reference valves from commissioning.
